array.string: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; source "$HOME/.zshenv" 2>/dev/null; : "$MC_HOMELAB_DIR"; tailscale_ip="$(tailscale ip -4)"; exec /opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-server --model "$MC_HOMELAB_DIR/whisper/models/ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin" --host "$tailscale_ip" --port 8081 --language auto --convert --request-path /v1/audio --inference-path /transcriptions
